notes: Machine-readable catalogue of the sticker effect library. Human reference: docs/effects.md.
A Kit test asserts this file matches the compiled library (EffectDefinition.library); edit both together.
Story tooling should read this file to learn which effects exist, what they mean, and which parameters each accepts.

effect.description: One of the effect names below.

sticker.description: Sticker ID from the pack manifest. Every placed instance of it is affected; if none is placed the trigger silently does not fire.

at.description: Seconds into this language's narration at which the effect starts.

cue.description: Authoring label only (e.g. the word it lines up with). Never interpreted by the app.

repeat.description: Cycles to run; "loop" runs until playback ends. Ignored by one-way effects.

duration.description: Seconds for ONE cycle. Total run time is duration × repeat.

intensity.description: Amplitude, never speed. 0 is visually identical to no effect.

color.description: Read by glow, tint and sparkle only. Required by tint.

hold.description: Keep the end state until playback ends. Meaningful for fade-in, fade-out, glow, tint only.

effects.name: pulse
effects.summary: One gentle size beat. The universal "look at this one".
effects.use: Draw attention to the sticker being talked about.

effects.name: wobble
effects.summary: Tilts side to side around its base. The default "this thing is reacting".
effects.use: Reactions: surprise, laughter, a sneeze, being bumped.

effects.name: shake
effects.summary: Fast, small horizontal tremble. Fear, cold, excitement.

effects.name: hop
effects.summary: One small arc up and back down. The most charming one in the list.
effects.use: Joy, a jump, saying hello, a heartbeat of excitement. repeat 2–3 for bouncing.

effects.name: spin
effects.summary: One full clockwise rotation about the centre.
effects.use: Twirling, dizziness, a pirouette, a tumble. Intensity does not change the turn (only 0 disables it).

effects.name: float
effects.summary: Very slow vertical bob. Built for loop.
effects.use: Anything airborne or afloat: butterflies, bees, birds, clouds, boats. Use repeat "loop".

effects.name: sway
effects.summary: Very slow tilt around the base. Trees, flowers, grass. Built for loop.
effects.use: Wind through plants; gentle idle life for scenery. Use repeat "loop".

effects.name: fade-in
effects.use: Arrivals, waking up, being noticed. Pair with puff for a magical entrance.

effects.name: fade-out
effects.use: Leaving, hiding, falling asleep. hold true keeps the sticker gone until the story ends; otherwise it fades back in.

effects.name: blink
effects.summary: Vanishes and returns, hard-edged, twice per cycle. Magical, unstable, teleporting.
effects.use: Magic, flickering lights, a firefly. Rate-limited to 3 flashes per second.

effects.name: glow
effects.summary: A soft bloom rises around the sticker and falls away. Reads as magic.
effects.use: Magic, warmth, a wish, the sun coming out. hold true keeps the bloom on.

effects.name: tint
effects.summary: A colour washes over the sticker and drains away. White + short duration = a flash.
effects.use: Blushing (pink), cold (blue), angry (red), a camera flash (white, duration 0.2). color is required.

effects.name: sparkle
effects.summary: A small shower of twinkles above the sticker. The generic magic/delight beat.
effects.use: Delight, magic, treasure, a good idea.

effects.name: puff
effects.summary: A small puff of smoke at the sticker's feet. Disappearing, landing, arriving.
effects.use: Landing after a jump, appearing/disappearing, a cloud of dust.

effects.name: hearts
effects.summary: A few hearts drift up. Affection, a hug, a friend.
